summary: Frontend-only portfolio smoke and responsive testing completed. Desktop navigation, mobile menu, contact validation/success flow, destinations, images, and mobile layout passed.
action_items: Consider supporting Escape to close the mobile navigation menu for stronger keyboard accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form success is frontend-only as specified; it does not send or persist a message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested frontend flows were exercised at 1920x800 and 390x844. No console/rendered errors or mobile horizontal overflow observed. Reduced-motion CSS rule was reviewed; preference was false during run.
rca of the issue: No blocking defects reproduced. The mobile menu closes on link navigation, but there is no Escape key handler in App.js; this is an accessibility enhancement rather than a flow failure.
